river_name: None (Not situated on the banks of a river)

ghats.name: Sacred Pushkarini (Koneru)
ghats.description: Sacred temple pond located near the south entrance of the temple complex, used for temple rituals and festive traditions.

significance: The temple features an ancient Pushkarini (temple pond) within its 3-acre premises. It is an urban land-based temple complex and not located along any riverbank.
safety_rules: Bathing or swimming inside the Pushkarini is strictly prohibited for public safety and water cleanliness. Devotees may perform Prokshana (sprinkling sacred water) from designated boundary areas.
